class.name: GDScriptAnnotation
class.brief_description: Abstract base for user-defined GDScript annotations.
class.description:
Extend this class to define an annotation that scripts can apply with [code]@[/code]. [codeblock] class_name MyCustomAnnotation extends GDScriptAnnotation
var my_dict: Dictionary = {} [/codeblock] A use such as [code]@MyCustomAnnotation(my_dict={"asd": "asda"})[/code] stores the folded attribute values on the compiled script. Read them with [method GDScript.get_annotations]. Applying an annotation does not construct [GDScriptAnnotation], and [code]_init[/code] is not called. Only a global [code]class_name[/code] that extends this class can be used as an annotation. The class cannot be abstract. [GDScriptAnnotation] itself is not a valid annotation.
